description: Create and monetize a YouTube gaming channel focused on simple, popular games (Minecraft, Roblox, etc.) with a family-friendly/adult audience. Includes full setup, content strategy, monetization (AdSense via foreign bank account), and growth plan.

phase_1_channel_setup.name: Channel Setup & Branding
phase_1_channel_setup.description: Create the YouTube channel, design branding, set up basic equipment.
tasks: Create YouTube channel with clear niche (Minecraft/Roblox focus)
Design channel art (avatar, banner, thumbnails style)
Write channel description and about section
Set up basic recording/streaming equipment (OBS, microphone, webcam optional)
Create a content calendar for first month

phase_2_content_production.name: Content Production & Publishing
phase_2_content_production.description: Produce and publish first batch of content (long-form + Shorts).
tasks: Publish 2 long-form videos per week (10-30 min each)
Publish 3-5 Shorts per week (clip highlights, memes, comparisons)
Optimize titles, descriptions, tags, and thumbnails for SEO
Engage with comments and build community
Analyze performance and adjust content strategy

phase_3_monetization_setup.name: Monetization Setup & Milestone Achievement
phase_3_monetization_setup.description: Reach YouTube Partner Program thresholds, set up AdSense with foreign bank account.
tasks: Reach 500 subscribers and 3000 watch hours for early access
Reach 1000 subscribers and 4000 watch hours for full monetization
Set up AdSense account (as 'Individual', not 'Business')
Link foreign bank account (Wise, Grey, or direct foreign card) to AdSense
Submit for YouTube Partner Program review
deliverables: AdSense account linked to foreign bank account

phase_4_growth_and_optimization.name: Growth & Optimization
phase_4_growth_and_optimization.description: Optimize content strategy for maximum growth and revenue.
tasks: Analyze best-performing content and double down
Experiment with new formats (streaming, collaborations)
Optimize revenue streams (memberships, super chats, sponsorships)
Explore cross-platform (TikTok, Instagram Reels)
Scale production to 3-4 long videos per week

adsense_setup.note: AdSense account type cannot be changed after creation. Choose 'Individual' for personal tax reporting.

financial_sustainability_notes.purpose: This work is a parallel financial sustainability track, similar to W-R-ECOMM-001 and W-R-RM-014.
financial_sustainability_notes.relationship: All three works aim to increase Gardener's financial independence, enabling full-time focus on Mandala Symbiosis.
financial_sustainability_notes.priority: This is a 'probe' work — test the waters with minimal investment, scale if successful.

notes: Start with Minecraft and Roblox — they have the largest audience and simplest content requirements.
Use Shorts as a funnel to long-form videos (Shorts bring subscribers, long videos bring revenue).
Foreign bank account is critical for payout — Wise or Grey are recommended for beginners.
AdSense account type must be 'Individual' — Business requires company registration.
Monitor performance closely and pivot to winning formats early.
source: Dialogue between Gardener (Voodoo) and External SR (DeepSeek), 2026-07-13
